signals.text: 7 open PM roles across 3 US offices

roles.title: Senior AI Product Manager | Growth & Transformation
roles.location: Charlotte, NC; New York City, NY

bullets: Drive Strategic Transformation: Act as the day-to-day lead on strategic banking initiatives, ensuring AI/ML solutions align with business objectives and client needs.
Build the Future of Banking: Identify opportunities for AI to create value, from automating complex financial workflows to building agentic systems for real-time client assistance.
End-to-End Ownership: Own the product lifecycle from initial business case and feasibility assessment to hands-on execution and long-term optimization.
Technical Leadership: Partner closely with engineering and data science teams to translate high-level banking goals into detailed technical deliverables.
Mentor & Influence: Manage and develop junior Product Managers, AI while serving as a high-visibility point person for senior stakeholders across the organization.
